source: Form N-400, edition 01/20/25; USCIS "Vocabulary for the Naturalization Interview: Self-Test 2"; USCIS "Understanding Commands for the Naturalization Interview"
ever: When a question includes the word “EVER,” you must provide information about any of your actions or conduct that occurred anywhere in the world at any time, unless the question specifies otherwise.

yesno.q: Have you EVER claimed to be a U.S. citizen (in writing or any other way)?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER said you were a U.S. citizen, in writing or in any other way?

yesno.q: Have you EVER registered to vote or voted in any Federal, state, or local election in the United States?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER registered to vote, or voted, in any federal, state, or local election in the United States?
yesno.note: If you lawfully voted only in a local election where aliens are eligible to vote, you may answer “No.”

yesno.q: Do you currently owe any overdue Federal, state, or local taxes in the United States?
yesno.plain: Right now, do you owe any federal, state, or local taxes in the United States that are past their due date?

yesno.q: Since you became a lawful permanent resident, have you called yourself a “nonresident alien” on a Federal, state, or local tax return or decided not to file a tax return because you considered yourself to be a nonresident?
yesno.plain: Since you became a permanent resident, have you called yourself a “nonresident alien” on a federal, state, or local tax return? Or, since you became a permanent resident, have you decided not to file a tax return because you thought of yourself as a nonresident?

yesno.q: Have you EVER been a member of, involved in, or in any way associated with any Communist or totalitarian party anywhere in the world?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER been a member of, involved in, or connected in any way with any Communist or totalitarian party, anywhere in the world?

yesno.q: Have you EVER advocated (supported and promoted) any of the following, or been a member of, involved in, or in any way associated with any group anywhere in the world that advocated any of the following: opposition to all organized government?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER supported and promoted being against all organized government, or been a member of, involved in, or connected in any way with any group anywhere in the world that did?

yesno.q: Have you EVER advocated (supported and promoted) any of the following, or been a member of, involved in, or in any way associated with any group anywhere in the world that advocated any of the following: world communism?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER supported and promoted world communism, or been a member of, involved in, or connected in any way with any group anywhere in the world that did?

yesno.q: Have you EVER advocated (supported and promoted) any of the following, or been a member of, involved in, or in any way associated with any group anywhere in the world that advocated any of the following: the establishment in the United States of a totalitarian dictatorship?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER supported and promoted setting up a totalitarian dictatorship in the United States, or been a member of, involved in, or connected in any way with any group anywhere in the world that did?

yesno.q: Have you EVER advocated (supported and promoted) any of the following, or been a member of, involved in, or in any way associated with any group anywhere in the world that advocated any of the following: the overthrow by force or violence or other unconstitutional means of the Government of the United States or all forms of law?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER supported and promoted overthrowing the Government of the United States, or all forms of law, by force, violence, or other unconstitutional means, or been a member of, involved in, or connected in any way with any group anywhere in the world that did?

yesno.q: Have you EVER advocated (supported and promoted) any of the following, or been a member of, involved in, or in any way associated with any group anywhere in the world that advocated any of the following: the unlawful assaulting or killing of any officer or officers of the Government of the United States or of any other organized government because of their official character?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER supported and promoted unlawfully attacking or killing any officer of the Government of the United States, or of any other organized government, because of the officer's official position, or been a member of, involved in, or connected in any way with any group anywhere in the world that did?

yesno.q: Have you EVER advocated (supported and promoted) any of the following, or been a member of, involved in, or in any way associated with any group anywhere in the world that advocated any of the following: the unlawful damage, injury, or destruction of property?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER supported and promoted unlawfully damaging, harming, or destroying property, or been a member of, involved in, or connected in any way with any group anywhere in the world that did?

yesno.q: Have you EVER advocated (supported and promoted) any of the following, or been a member of, involved in, or in any way associated with any group anywhere in the world that advocated any of the following: sabotage?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER supported and promoted sabotage, or been a member of, involved in, or connected in any way with any group anywhere in the world that did?

yesno.q: Have you EVER been a member of, involved in, or in any way associated with, or have you EVER provided money, a thing of value, services or labor, or any other assistance or support to a group that used a weapon or explosive with intent to harm another person or cause damage to property?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER been a member of, involved in, or connected in any way with a group that used a weapon or explosive in order to harm another person or damage property? Or have you EVER given such a group money, anything of value, services or labor, or any other help or support?

yesno.q: Have you EVER been a member of, involved in, or in any way associated with, or have you EVER provided money, a thing of value, services or labor, or any other assistance or support to a group that engaged (participated) in kidnapping, assassination, or hijacking or sabotage of an airplane, ship, vehicle, or other mode of transportation?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER been a member of, involved in, or connected in any way with a group that took part in kidnapping, assassination, or the hijacking or sabotage of an airplane, ship, vehicle, or other kind of transportation? Or have you EVER given such a group money, anything of value, services or labor, or any other help or support?

yesno.q: Have you EVER been a member of, involved in, or in any way associated with, or have you EVER provided money, a thing of value, services or labor, or any other assistance or support to a group that threatened, attempted (tried), conspired (planned with others), prepared, planned, advocated for, or incited (encouraged) others to commit any of the acts listed in Item Numbers 6.a. or 6.b.?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER been a member of, involved in, or connected in any way with a group that threatened, tried, planned with others, prepared, planned, supported and promoted, or encouraged others to do any of the acts in 6.a or 6.b? Or have you EVER given such a group money, anything of value, services or labor, or any other help or support?

yesno.q: Have you EVER ordered, incited, called for, committed, assisted, helped with, or otherwise participated in any of the following: torture?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER ordered, encouraged, called for, done, helped with, or taken part in any other way in torture?

yesno.q: Have you EVER ordered, incited, called for, committed, assisted, helped with, or otherwise participated in any of the following: genocide?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER ordered, encouraged, called for, done, helped with, or taken part in any other way in genocide?

yesno.q: Have you EVER ordered, incited, called for, committed, assisted, helped with, or otherwise participated in any of the following: killing or trying to kill any person?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER ordered, encouraged, called for, done, helped with, or taken part in any other way in killing or trying to kill any person?

yesno.q: Have you EVER ordered, incited, called for, committed, assisted, helped with, or otherwise participated in any of the following: intentionally and severely injuring or trying to injure any person?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER ordered, encouraged, called for, done, helped with, or taken part in any other way in badly injuring any person on purpose, or trying to injure any person?

yesno.q: Have you EVER ordered, incited, called for, committed, assisted, helped with, or otherwise participated in any of the following: any kind of sexual contact or activity with any person who did not consent (did not agree) or was unable to consent (could not agree), or was being forced or threatened by you or by someone else?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER ordered, encouraged, called for, done, helped with, or taken part in any other way in any kind of sexual contact or activity with a person who did not agree, could not agree, or was being forced or threatened by you or by someone else?

yesno.q: Have you EVER ordered, incited, called for, committed, assisted, helped with, or otherwise participated in any of the following: not letting someone practice his or her religion?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER ordered, encouraged, called for, done, helped with, or taken part in any other way in not letting someone practice his or her religion?

yesno.q: Have you EVER ordered, incited, called for, committed, assisted, helped with, or otherwise participated in any of the following: causing harm or suffering to any person because of his or her race, religion, national origin, membership in a particular social group, or political opinion?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER ordered, encouraged, called for, done, helped with, or taken part in any other way in causing harm or suffering to any person because of his or her race, religion, national origin, membership in a particular social group, or political opinion?
words: membership in a particular social group

yesno.q: Have you EVER served in, been a member of, assisted (helped), or participated in any military or police unit?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER served in, been a member of, helped, or taken part in any military or police unit?

yesno.q: Have you EVER served in, been a member of, assisted (helped), or participated in any armed group (a group that carries weapons), for example: paramilitary unit (a group of people who act like a military group but are not part of the official military), self-defense unit, vigilante unit, rebel group, or guerrilla group?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER served in, been a member of, helped, or taken part in any armed group (a group that carries weapons)? Examples are a paramilitary unit, self-defense unit, vigilante unit, rebel group, or guerrilla group.

yesno.q: Have you EVER worked, volunteered, or otherwise served in a place where people were detained (forced to stay), for example, a prison, jail, prison camp (a camp where prisoners of war or political prisoners are kept), detention facility, or labor camp, or have you EVER directed or participated in any other activity that involved detaining people?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER worked, volunteered, or served in any other way in a place where people were forced to stay? Examples are a prison, jail, prison camp, detention facility, or labor camp. Or have you EVER directed or taken part in any other activity that involved detaining people?

yesno.q: Were you EVER a part of any group, or did you EVER help any group, unit, or organization that used a weapon against any person, or threatened to do so?
yesno.plain: Were you EVER part of any group, or did you EVER help any group, unit, or organization, that used a weapon against any person or threatened to do so?

yesno.q: If you answered “Yes” to Item Number 10.a., when you were part of this group, or when you helped this group, did you ever use a weapon against another person?
yesno.plain: If you answered “Yes” to 10.a: while you were part of this group, or helping it, did you ever use a weapon against another person?

yesno.q: If you answered “Yes” to Item Number 10.a., when you were part of this group, or when you helped this group, did you ever threaten another person that you would use a weapon against that person?
yesno.plain: If you answered “Yes” to 10.a: while you were part of this group, or helping it, did you ever threaten another person that you would use a weapon against that person?

yesno.q: Have you EVER sold, provided, or transported weapons, or assisted any person in selling, providing, or transporting weapons, which you knew or believed would be used against another person?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER sold, provided, or transported weapons, or helped any person to do so, when you knew or believed the weapons would be used against another person?

yesno.q: Have you EVER received any weapons training, paramilitary training, or other military-type training?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER been given any weapons training, paramilitary training, or other military-type training?

yesno.q: Have you EVER recruited (asked), enlisted (signed up), conscripted (required to join), or used any person under 15 years of age to serve in or help an armed group, or attempted or worked with others to do so?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER recruited (asked), enlisted (signed up), conscripted (required to join), or used any person under 15 years old to serve in or help an armed group? Or have you EVER tried to, or worked with others to do so?

yesno.q: Have you EVER used any person under 15 years of age to take part in hostilities or attempted or worked with others to do so?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER used any person under 15 years old to take part in hostilities? Or have you EVER tried to, or worked with others to do so?
yesno.note: This could include participating in combat or providing services related to combat (such as serving as a messenger or transporting supplies).

yesno.q: Have you EVER committed, agreed to commit, asked someone else to commit, helped commit, or tried to commit a crime or offense for which you were NOT arrested?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER committed a crime or offense, agreed to commit one, asked someone else to commit one, helped commit one, or tried to commit one, for which you were NOT arrested?
yesno.note: If you answer “Yes” to any part of Item Number 15. below, complete the table below with each crime or offense even if your records have been sealed, expunged, or otherwise cleared. You must disclose this information even if someone, including a judge, law enforcement officer, or attorney, told you that it is no longer on your record, or told you that you do not have to disclose the information.

yesno.q: Have you EVER been arrested, cited, detained or confined by any law enforcement officer, military official (in the U.S. or elsewhere), or immigration official for any reason, or been charged with a crime or offense?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER been arrested, cited, detained, or confined by any law enforcement officer, military official (in the U.S. or elsewhere), or immigration official, for any reason? Or have you EVER been charged with a crime or offense?
yesno.note: If you answer “Yes” to any part of Item Number 15. below, complete the table below with each crime or offense even if your records have been sealed, expunged, or otherwise cleared. You must disclose this information even if someone, including a judge, law enforcement officer, or attorney, told you that it is no longer on your record, or told you that you do not have to disclose the information.

yesno.q: If you received a suspended sentence, were placed on probation, or were paroled, have you completed your suspended sentence, probation, or parole?
yesno.plain: If you were given a suspended sentence, put on probation, or paroled: have you completed your suspended sentence, probation, or parole?

yesno.q: Have you EVER engaged in prostitution, attempted to procure or import prostitutes or persons for the purpose of prostitution, or received any proceeds or money from prostitution?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER taken part in prostitution? Have you EVER tried to get, or bring into the country, prostitutes or other persons for prostitution? Have you EVER received any proceeds or money from prostitution?

yesno.q: Have you EVER manufactured, cultivated, produced, distributed, dispensed, sold, or smuggled (trafficked) any controlled substances, illegal drugs, narcotics, or drug paraphernalia in violation of any law or regulation of a U.S. state, the United States, or a foreign country?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER made, grown, produced, distributed, given out, sold, or smuggled (trafficked) any controlled substances, illegal drugs, narcotics, or drug paraphernalia, against any law or regulation of a U.S. state, the United States, or a foreign country?

yesno.q: Have you EVER been married to more than one person at the same time?
Have you EVER married someone in order to obtain an immigration benefit?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER married someone in order to get an immigration benefit?

yesno.q: Have you EVER helped anyone to enter, or try to enter, the United States illegally?
Have you EVER gambled illegally or received income from illegal gambling?
Have you EVER failed to support your dependents (pay child support) or to pay alimony (court-ordered financial support after divorce or separation)?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER failed to support your dependents (pay child support)? Have you EVER failed to pay alimony (financial support that a court ordered after divorce or separation)?

yesno.q: Have you EVER made any misrepresentation to obtain any public benefit in the United States?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER given false or misleading information, in words or in documents, in order to get any public benefit in the United States?

yesno.q: Have you EVER given any U.S. Government officials any information or documentation that was false, fraudulent, or misleading?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER given any U.S. Government official any information or document that was false, fraudulent, or misleading?

yesno.q: Have you EVER lied to any U.S. Government officials to gain entry or admission into the United States or to gain immigration benefits while in the United States?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER lied to any U.S. Government official in order to enter or be admitted into the United States, or in order to get immigration benefits while in the United States?

yesno.q: Have you EVER been placed in removal, rescission, or deportation proceedings?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER been put in removal, rescission, or deportation proceedings (a formal legal case)?

yesno.q: Have you EVER been removed or deported from the United States?
Are you a male who lived in the United States at any time between your 18th and 26th birthdays?
yesno.plain: Are you male, and did you live in the United States at any time between your 18th birthday and your 26th birthday?
yesno.note: (Do not select “Yes” if you were a lawful nonimmigrant for all of that time period.)

yesno.q: If you answered “Yes,” to Item Number 22.a., did you register for the Selective Service?
yesno.plain: If you answered “Yes” to 22.a: did you register for the Selective Service?

yesno.q: Have you EVER left the United States to avoid being drafted in the U.S. armed forces?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER left the United States in order to avoid being drafted into the U.S. armed forces?

yesno.q: Have you EVER applied for any kind of exemption from military service in the U.S. armed forces?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER applied to be excused, in any way, from military service in the U.S. armed forces?

yesno.q: Have you EVER served in the U.S. armed forces?
Are you currently a member of the U.S. armed forces?
yesno.plain: Are you a member of the U.S. armed forces now?

yesno.q: If you answered “Yes” to Item Number 26.a., are you scheduled to deploy outside the United States, including to a vessel, within the next 3 months?
yesno.plain: If you answered “Yes” to 26.a: are you scheduled to deploy (be sent) outside the United States, including to a vessel (ship), within the next 3 months?

yesno.q: If you answered “Yes,” to Item Number 26.a., are you currently stationed outside the United States?
yesno.plain: If you answered “Yes” to 26.a: are you stationed (based) outside the United States now?

yesno.q: If you answered “No” to Item Number 26.a., are you a former U.S. military service member who is currently residing outside of the U.S.?
yesno.plain: If you answered “No” to 26.a: are you a former U.S. military service member who now lives outside the United States?

yesno.q: Have you EVER been court-martialed or have you received a discharge characterized as other than honorable, bad conduct, or dishonorable, while in the U.S. armed forces?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER been court-martialed, or received a discharge described as other than honorable, bad conduct, or dishonorable, while in the U.S. armed forces?

yesno.q: Have you EVER been discharged from training or service in the U.S. armed forces because you were an alien?
yesno.plain: Have you EVER been discharged (released) from training or service in the U.S. armed forces because you were an alien?

yesno.q: Have you EVER deserted from the U.S. armed forces?
Do you now have, or did you EVER have, a hereditary title or an order of nobility in any foreign country?
yesno.plain: Do you have now, or did you EVER have, a hereditary title or an order of nobility in any foreign country?

yesno.q: If you answered “Yes,” to Item Number 30.a., are you willing to give up any inherited titles or orders of nobility that you have in a foreign country at your naturalization ceremony?
yesno.plain: If you answered “Yes” to 30.a: are you willing to give up, at your naturalization ceremony, any inherited titles or orders of nobility that you have in a foreign country?

yesno.q: Do you support the Constitution and form of Government of the United States?
yesno.plain: Do you support the Constitution and the system of government of the United States?

yesno.q: Do you understand the full Oath of Allegiance to the United States (see Part 16. Oath of Allegiance)?
yesno.plain: Do you understand all of the Oath of Allegiance to the United States?

yesno.q: Are you unable to take the Oath of Allegiance because of a physical or developmental disability or mental impairment?
yesno.plain: Because of a physical disability, a developmental disability, or a mental impairment, are you not able to take the Oath of Allegiance?

yesno.q: Are you willing to take the full Oath of Allegiance to the United States?
yesno.plain: Are you willing to take the whole Oath of Allegiance to the United States?

yesno.q: If the law requires it, are you willing to bear arms (carry weapons) on behalf of the United States?
yesno.plain: If the law requires it, are you willing to carry weapons on behalf of the United States?

yesno.q: If the law requires it, are you willing to perform noncombatant services (do something that does not include fighting in a war) in the U.S. armed forces?
yesno.plain: If the law requires it, are you willing to do work in the U.S. armed forces that does not include fighting in a war?

yesno.q: If the law requires it, are you willing to perform work of national importance under civilian direction (do non-military work that the U.S. Government says is important to the country)?
yesno.plain: If the law requires it, are you willing to do non-military work that the U.S. Government says is important to the country?
words: work of national importance under civilian direction

oath.text: I hereby declare on oath, that I absolutely and entirely renounce and abjure all allegiance and fidelity to any foreign prince, potentate, state, or sovereignty, of whom or which I have heretofore been a subject or citizen; that I will support and defend the Constitution and laws of the United States of America against all enemies, foreign, and domestic; that I will bear true faith and allegiance to the same; that I will bear arms on behalf of the United States when required by the law; that I will perform noncombatant service in the armed forces of the United States when required by the law; that I will perform work of national importance under civilian direction when required by the law; and that I take this obligation freely, without any mental reservation or purpose of evasion; so help me God.
plain: I state under oath that I completely give up all loyalty to any foreign ruler or country that I was a subject or citizen of before.
I will support and defend the Constitution and laws of the United States against all enemies, from other countries and from inside the country.
I will be truly faithful and loyal to the Constitution and laws of the United States.
When the law requires it, I will carry weapons for the United States.
When the law requires it, I will do service in the U.S. armed forces that does not include fighting.
When the law requires it, I will do non-military work that the U.S. Government says is important to the country.
I make this promise freely, with no secret intention to hold anything back and no plan to avoid it, and I ask God to help me.
